relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG) infiltration by macrophages contributes to paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy through activating Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) and upregulating monocyte chemotactic protein 1 (MCP-1) expression

relationships.subject: IL-17A
relationships.evidence_quote: elevated IL-17/IL-17A levels promote the microglial activation and further exacerbate pain intensity

relationships.subject: IL-10
relationships.evidence_quote: Krukowski et al. have identified CD8+ T cells and endogenous interleukin (IL)-10 as potent factors for resolution of CIPN.

key_findings: Review: tumor-associated macrophages, T cells, neutrophils and dendritic cells contribute to cancer-related neuropathic pain.
Mechanisms include TLR4/MCP-1 macrophage infiltration of DRG, JAK2/STAT3 signaling, Th17/Treg imbalance and IL-10 mediated resolution.
